metadata.question: Did surface water extent in southern Iran increase on January 7, 2022 compared to December 14, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use JRC Global Surface Water or Sentinel-1 SAR for water detection - Alternatively, use Sentinel-2 with NDWI/MNDWI for water mapping - Dates: December 14, 2021 and January 7, 2022 - Location: Southern Iran (approximate region around 28°N, 53°E) 2. Masking strategy: - For Sentinel-2: Apply cloud masking, then calculate water index (MNDWI > 0 or NDWI > 0) - For Sentinel-1: Use VV polarization, water typically has low backscatter - Count water pixels for each date 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - If no images found: C1 - If images exist but all pixels masked: C2 - If calculation returns None/NaN: C3 - Compare water pixel counts: increase = A, decrease/same = B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define southern Iran region const southernIran = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[48, 25], [60, 25], [60, 32], [48, 32], [48, 25]] ]); const date1 = '2021-12-14'; const date2 = '2022-01-07'; // Function to mask clouds in Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Get Sentinel-2 data for date 1 let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(southernIran) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .map(maskS2clouds); let size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); if (size1 === 0) { col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(southernIran) .filterDate(ee.Date(date1).advance(-5, 'day'), ee.Date(date1).advance(5, 'day')) .map(maskS2clouds); size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); } // Get Sentinel-2 data for date 2 let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(southernIran) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .map(maskS2clouds); let size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); if (size2 === 0) { col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(southernIran) .filterDate(ee.Date(date2).advance(-5, 'day'), ee.Date(date2).advance(5, 'day')) .map(maskS2clouds); size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); } console.log(`Dec 2021 Images: ${size1}, Jan 2022 Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("No data available for one or both dates."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Calculate MNDWI (Modified Normalized Difference Water Index) function addMNDWI(image) { const mndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('MNDWI'); return image.addBands(mndwi); } const img1 = col1.map(addMNDWI).median(); const img2 = col2.map(addMNDWI).median(); // Water mask: MNDWI > 0 const water1 = img1.select('MNDWI').gt(0); const water2 = img2.select('MNDWI').gt(0); // Count water pixels const stats1 = await water1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: southernIran, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = await water2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: southernIran, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const waterPixels1 = stats1.MNDWI; const waterPixels2 = stats2.MNDWI; console.log(`Dec 2021 Water Pixels: ${waterPixels1}`); console.log(`Jan 2022 Water Pixels: ${waterPixels2}`); if (waterPixels1 === null || waterPixels2 === null || waterPixels1 === undefined || waterPixels2 === undefined) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid results."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (waterPixels1 === 0 && waterPixels2 === 0) { console.log("No valid water pixels detected for both dates."); console.log("C2"); return; } const percentChange = ((waterPixels2 - waterPixels1) / waterPixels1 * 100).toFixed(2); console.log(`Change: ${percentChange}%`); if (waterPixels2 > waterPixels1) { console.log("Surface water extent increased."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Surface water extent did not increase."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
